title: Bank or payment request
summary: An unexpected request asks you to transfer money or approve a payment.
scenario: The message presents a payment as urgent, secret, reversible, or required to avoid a penalty.
warning_signs: Requests to keep the transfer secret
safe_actions: Pause before opening a payment app
Verify the request with the person or organization using known details
Do not approve an unfamiliar payment
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider promptly through a known channel
Monitor the account and keep the transaction reference
reporting_guidance: Use only independently checked reporting routes
prevention_tips: Use a second channel for new payment instructions
false_positive_notes: A real urgent payment can still wait for an independent confirmation.
